title: [DEV] NSClient keeps re-uploading profiles 2 times per minute
symptom: AAPS keeps syncing (resending) the profile with Nightscout 2 times per minute, causing the database to grow larger and larger. The issue starts after a profile switch or directly after upgrading to certain dev versions.
cause: The profile upload is not acknowledged by Nightscout, leading to repeated uploads. The issue was fixed by a commit that addressed profile store upload.
fix: The issue was resolved by commit 3472f0f83e81164869453e580094677ceb1e5b73, which fixed the profile store upload. Users also used a Python script to remove duplicate profile entries from MongoDB.
